title: Teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5fd0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a6fa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow/ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#1c3a55'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M72 48 Q88 44 92 30 Q93 26 89 26 Q84 30 80 40 Q78 46 72 50 Z' fill='#7fe0ff' stroke='#b9f2ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q10 46 10 60 Q10 74 28 72' fill='none' stroke='#7fe0ff' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 44 Q14 47 14 60 Q14 71 28 70' fill='none' stroke='#c9f7ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#potGrad)' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <path d='M31 45 Q50 33 69 45 Z' fill='#7fe0ff' stroke='#c9f7ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='19' ry='4' fill='#3f9bd6' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#fff0b3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- spout opening glow -->
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='28' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#fff4c2'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='58' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#bff2ff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- steam puffs -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='4' fill='#d9f6ff' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='18' r='3.2' fill='#d9f6ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='23' r='2.6' fill='#d9f6ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
